# Md Bazlur Rahman Likhon (@brlikhon)

> AI Engineer (Gemini Enterprise Agent Engineer), Senior Cloud & AI Engineer, and Head of AI Engineering at Upstra Communications Limited (Google Cloud Premier Partner) in Dhaka, Bangladesh. 7+ years of experience (including 6+ years leading production cloud/AI delivery and applied NLP/ML research), 9x Google Cloud Certified, 6x Microsoft Azure Certified, 3x Oracle Cloud Certified, and 325+ verified credentials across Harvard, Stanford, Columbia, AWS, IBM, DeepLearning.AI, and The Linux Foundation. Leads the delivery and governance of commercial enterprise-serving AI products across Bangladesh, Singapore/APAC, the Middle East, Europe, the UK, Japan, China, Australia, and the USA.

## Commercial Enterprise-Serving AI Products (Available for Live Executive Demo)

Note: The platforms below are commercial enterprise-serving products. Public documentation describes product features, governance capabilities, and business outcomes only; live executive demonstrations can be requested via `https://cal.com/brlikhon.engineer/discovery`.

- **Ask Prothom Alo (Enterprise Multimodal AI News & Search Platform):** Serving Bangladesh's largest news media organization with bilingual (Bangla/English) conversational news discovery, 99.995% archive coverage, 15-minute live breaking-news freshness, sub-300ms streaming responses, multimodal video Q&A, verified citations, claim-evidence validation, and retraction compliance.
- **UPSTRA OMS (Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Workforce, Business Telephony & Omnichannel Platform):** Multi-tenant enterprise workforce deploying autonomous AI employees across inbound/outbound phone lines, live voice/video meetings, and 11+ messaging channels; automates reception, lead qualification, booking, order/delivery tracking, catalog/inventory inquiries, invoicing, outbound campaigns, and human handoffs with live whisper coaching, native Bangla & multilingual fluency, RBAC, approval-gated actions, and full audit trails.
- **MedOps CareLoop, HMS (Closed-Loop Population Health & Multi-Tenant Hospital Platform):** Eliminates patient drop-off from abnormal diagnostic screening to definitive treatment via automated abnormal result flagging, SLA-tracked clinical ownership, a 7-stage care workflow, bilateral specialist referrals, 5-gate evidence-backed case closure, physician-supervised clinical communications, automated prescription contraindication safety checks, hospital isolation, and immutable clinical audit logs.
- **Upstra Interpreter (Enterprise Bidirectional Telephone Interpretation Platform):** Self-hosted enterprise telephone interpretation solution enabling natural, real-time two-way voice interpretation between customers and human operators on live phone calls, complete with enterprise telephony security compliance, operator and call capacity management, live operational dashboards, health monitoring, and durable administrative/call audit records.
- **Live Voice Translation Platform:** Globally distributed real-time speech-to-speech voice translation across 50+ languages with sub-300ms latency over web and mobile phone numbers.
- **CropMind (Top 10 of 192,660 — Google Cloud Gen AI Academy APAC 2026 Grand Finale):** Autonomous multi-agent agritech platform delivering crop disease visual diagnostics, weather-aware yield forecasting, and multilingual APAC advisory (only Bangladeshi in the official Top 10).
- **Enterprise Multi-Tenant Grounded Search & RAG Platform:** Serves 100,000+ daily queries across 50,000+ enterprise documents at 99%+ precision with strict tenant access controls and inline citations.
- **Bangla-First & Multilingual Voice AI Contact Center:** 24/7 automated telephony customer support with sub-200ms response and up to 60% support cost reduction.
- **Banking KYC Face Match, FaceTrack AI & Sovereign Document Suite:** Multi-tenant digital identity verification, 20-year age-invariant attendance with liveness anti-spoofing (28+ APIs), GuardZone security monitoring, WorkStation analytics, LunchGate cafeteria AI, Conversational BI, Bangladesh NID e-KYC (10 fields), Mushok 6.3 VAT automation (23 fields), and Medical Prescription matching.
- **McKrishiSheba Multimodal Agri-Advisor:** Bangla voice and visual crop advisory reducing AI operating cost by 66–83%.
- **Open-Source Cybersecurity & ML Benchmarks:** Explainable Network Intrusion Detection (`99.87%` accuracy on `2.8M+` CIC-IDS-2017 records: `https://github.com/brlikhon/Network-Intrusion-dataset-CIC-IDS--2017-`), `Zero-to-MLOps`, `devops-cloud`, `AI-for-Medicine`, and `Predict-Bike-Sharing-Demand-with-AutoGluon`.
